name: New Space Age
detailed_description:
New Space Age

A turn-based grand strategy game about the colonization of the Solar System.
Lead a powerful corporation and build the first sustainable infrastructure beyond Earth. Design rockets, launch missions, extract resources, and forge a path from Earth's orbit to the farthest reaches of the Solar System.

The Dawn of a New Era

The game begins in the year 2030 — a time of rapid growth in private spaceflight and fierce competition among global tech powers.
Choose a country as the base for your corporation — each offers unique economic, scientific, and geopolitical bonuses that shape your starting conditions and strategic direction.

Realistic Solar System Colonization

The game covers all major planets, moons, and Kuiper Belt objects — from Mercury to Pluto.
You'll gain access to maps based on real topographic data: the craters of the Moon, the valleys of Mars, Enceladus’s geysers, Europa’s icy plains, and dozens of other celestial bodies with authentic geographic names.

Each body presents unique conditions: surface composition, temperature, lighting, and logistical challenges. You'll need to factor these in when choosing your priorities for exploration and development.

21st Century Technologies and Engineering

All in-game technologies are based on real or actively developed engineering solutions — from reusable rockets and nuclear tugs to solar power stations and autonomous drilling complexes.
Design your own rockets, satellites, spacecraft, stations, factories, and modules. Technological advancement depends on your choices, research approach, and investment priorities.

The tech tree is extensive and multidisciplinary — you define your own path to progress.

Missions and Strategic Planning

Plan and launch missions to planets, moons, and asteroids. Set objectives, choose payloads, plot routes, and determine module deployment sequences.
A mission is only one step. You'll be able to establish lunar supply routes, build orbital logistics hubs, launch scientific expeditions, or begin constructing permanent settlements.

Success requires resources, production capacity, and scientific expertise. You must balance immediate needs with long-term strategic goals.

Economy, Logistics, and Management

Build a sustainable economic system: extract resources, refine materials, and supply your bases and stations.
Design production chains — from asteroid mining to satellite assembly in orbital factories. Each link requires careful management, and a single error can be costly.

Logistics efficiency, energy distribution, and transport capacity management will determine the success of your entire infrastructure.

Competition and Influence

Other corporations are also operating in space — each with their own agendas. Compete for resources, scientific dominance, prestige, and economic contracts.
Advance your interests: invest in science, boost your corporate rating, shape the narrative, and expand your presence throughout the Solar System.

Create a New Space Age

New Space Age is a strategy game where you gradually build humanity’s path to living beyond Earth: from early launches to Martian colonies, from solar observation missions to resource extraction on Pluto.
Establish your own space industry, develop a unique approach, and become the leader of a new era.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2-го поколения) или AMD FX
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 или аналогичная с поддержкой DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Любая, совместимая с DirectX
  • VR Support: Не поддерживается
  • Additional Notes: Для игры не требуется постоянное подключение к интернету
